hostname.description: The hostname this host will report to remote systems (e.g., in network output). Set to empty string to auto-detect.

fqdn_lookup.description: Whether to perform full DNS lookups for hostnames. Set to false in environments with unreliable DNS.

base_dir.description: Base directory where collectd stores persistent state (e.g., plugin values, state files).

plugin_dir.description: Directory where collectd loads plugin modules (.so files) from.

plugin_cache_file.description: Path to optional plugin cache file for automatic plugin loading. Leave empty to disable.

enabled_plugins.description: List of plugin names to load (e.g., ['cpu', 'memory', 'network']). Plugins must exist in plugin_dir.

interval.description: Global collection interval in seconds. Plugins may override this with their own Interval directive.

read_threads.description: Number of threads used for reading (collecting) metrics. Increase if collection latency is high.

write_threads.description: Number of threads used for writing (outputting) metrics. Increase if output lag occurs.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging. One of: debug, info, notice, warning, err.

log_file.description: Path to log file. If empty or unset, logs go to syslog instead.

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use if logging to syslog. Ignored if log_file is set.

ttl.description: Time-to-live for multicast UDP packets (used by the 'network' plugin).

include_snippets.description: List of file paths to include additional configuration blocks (e.g., '/etc/collectd/conf.d/*.conf').

plugins_config.description: Detailed configuration blocks for plugins not covered by global flags. Each item defines a <Plugin> section.

options.description: Key-value pairs for plugin-level directives (strings, numbers, booleans).

list_items.description: Nested sub-sections (e.g., <Host>, <Listener>) in this plugin block.
